decisions.structure: Modular sprites; do not generate the Cartesian product of identities, colors, poses and equipment
decisions.humans_and_goblins: Natural human skin tones appropriate to nineteenth-century Argentina
decisions.beast_colors: Typical natural colors of the selected animal
decisions.python: Deterministic cutting, anchors, masks and packing explicitly authorized
decisions.in_game_editor: Skin/fur tone and beast form; saved race and sex remain fixed
decisions.first_person: Bare skin/fur unless actual Hands-slot gloves are equipped; broken gloves remain worn
